profile.headline: Front-End Engineer | React, TypeScript, Node.js | 15+ years building for the web
profile.summary:
I'm a front-end engineer with 15+ years of experience building websites, web apps and productivity tools. Most recently I spent a decade at Nulab, working with a US and Japan team on the UI for products like Backlog and Cacoo, and leading the consolidation of several sites onto one React, TypeScript and Gatsby codebase.

Alongside that, I run Veecho, a freelance practice covering design, front-end development and WordPress and Shopify builds, and I work with SEM Works on client sites and email campaigns. I like turning mockups into fast, clean interfaces, and I'm comfortable on the back end too (Node, Go, PHP).

I'm looking for a front-end role where I can keep growing, and I'm open to learning new tools and stacks. English and Spanish, fluent.

positions.title: Front-End Web Developer
positions.description: Front-end web developer overseeing higher education web strategies and email marketing. Specializing in ADA Compliant web sites, micro sites, HTML email and video editing and marketing. Consult and revise RFPs as well as maintain the company's web site.

positions.title: Founder / Web Consultant and Front-End Developer
positions.description: Self-employed web consultant, designer and coder facilitating web sites to clients in the U.S. and internationally. Veecho specializes in WordPress, HTML5 & CCS3 and responsive web layouts.

positions.title: Front-End Engineer
positions.description:
-Update and maintain marketing site for nulab.com, cacoo.com and backlog.com using company standards and guidelines.
-Assist with product development and growth hacking.
-Collaborate with software engineers on new features implementations.
positions.insights: Skills: WordPress · React.js · GatsbyJS · TypeScript · Figma (Software) · Node.js · Docker · Go (Programming Language)

positions.title: Instructional Technology Consultant
positions.description: Part of the online team in charge of developing online courses. Immediate responsibilities were to design and code course for online delivery. Helped conceptualize, design and code highly interactive Flash based learning objects for online courses. Brought new technologies to existing department site and existing online courses sites (WordPress, jQuery, social media integraion, etc.)

positions.title: Web Master
positions.description: Built UNCG's (www.uncg.edu) web site based on ADA Compliance, modern table-less code CSS2 and a template system. Worked along University News and Photography Departments to implement deliveries of such. Worked with numerous departments and schools to facilitate web standards, best practices, and implementation of University mandated guidelines.

projects.title: The Spartan Project UNCG
projects.description: A WordPress rework for a crowdsourcing initiative led by the the Annual Giving Office of UNCG. The site consists of responsive CSS media queries to adapt the site to user friendly views via mobile, tablet and desktop using Bootstrap. Biggest challenge was to adapt a responsive flare to an already existing UNCG WordPress template structure. Design and code by Veecho (myself).
